'''Worrumba''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as second in command of [[White Team (Mortex)|White Team]] during the [[Battle for Black Ice|assault]] on the ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]''. He owed a [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] to [[Untos Poquot]], and was more interested in protecting his friend than the objectives of the Rebellion. He was killed in the attack on the ''Black Ice''.
